newsitem.title: UK: Opinion poll puts UK Labour well ahead.
newsitem.headline: Opinion poll puts UK Labour well ahead.

text.p: The main opposition Labour Party is 20 points ahead of the ruling Conservatives in the run up to Britain's May 1 general election, according to an opinion poll published in a Sunday newspaper.
The ICM poll for The Observer gave Labour 50 percent of the vote to 30 percent for the Conservatives and 14 percent for the Liberal Democrats.
ICM carried out its poll of 1,793 adults between last Wednesday and Friday, before Labour Leader Tony Blair suffered his first real setback of the campaign over plans for devolving power to Scotland.
